camel_example: aliyun iot BatchBindDevicesIntoProject --region cn-hangzhou --Devices.1.DeviceName Ee2000000 --Devices.1.ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --ProjectId a12000000
description_en: Associates devices with a project in a batch
description_zh: 调用该接口批量关联设备到项目中
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-bind-devices-into-project --project-id a12000000 --devices ProductKey=a1BwAGV0000 DeviceName=Ee2000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchBindDevicesIntoProject

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The project ID.
Log on to the IoT Studio console (https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the corresponding instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and view the ID in the address bar
parameters.help_zh:
项目ID。
您可登录物联网应用开发控制台 (https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看
parameters.name: project_id
